title: feat(i18n): complete Spanish locale — 9 missing keys translated
head: eddyflores100-lang:feat/complete-spanish-locale
body:
## Summary

Closes #1507.

The existing `es.json` was missing 9 keys that exist in `en.json`. This PR translates all 9:

| Key | Translation |
|-----|-------------|
| `choice.mouse_help` | Pulsa y para activar o n para desactivar... |
| `choice.mouse_prompt` | ¿Activar soporte para ratón? [s/n] |
| `common.logs` | Registros |
| `common.no_logs_yet` | Sin registros todavía |
| `composer.encrypt_pgp` | Cifrar correo (PGP) |
| `composer.sign_pgp` | Firmar correo (PGP) |
| `composer.sign_smime` | Firmar correo (S/MIME) |
| `settings_general.mouse_support` | Soporte para ratón |
| `settings_general.show_original_on_reply` | Mostrar original al responder |

## Result

**234/234 keys** — 100% Spanish locale coverage.

Translations follow the existing style in `es.json`. Technical terms (PGP, S/MIME) kept as-is. `s/n` used instead of `y/n` for yes/no in Spanish.
